## Citation

Each package has its own citation. In R:

``` r
citation("densnv")
```

The Python packages include a `CITATION.cff` file, shown by GitHub as "Cite this repository".

## Data

The Vector-Borne Diseases datasets of SINAVE are for the exclusive use of the staff of the State Ministries of Health and of the federal level. The geographic boundaries come from [INEGI](https://www.inegi.org.mx/temas/mg) and [INE](https://pautas.ine.mx/transparencia/mapas/).
